kpi: Assigned attempts vs daily forecast; projected utilisation
threshold: >10% forecast variance over 3 days OR >95% standard utilisation over 2 days
mitigation: Rebalance routes; use contingency only after refreshed 28-day budget; prioritise ageing orders
basis: Stress tests +10% and +20%; volume is uniform within each forecast week, not an observed daily pattern

kpi: Attempts per new-hire paid day relative to comparable experienced agents
threshold: Below 60% in days 1-7; red flag below 40% for 2 days; below 85% by day 10
mitigation: Buddy routes, dispatch support and targeted coaching; revisit gap before adding staff
basis: Base 60% first 7 days, then 100%; stress 40% first week

kpi: Agent-side holds per 100 new orders, adjusted for workload; dispatch adherence
threshold: Day 7: <90% dispatch checklist adherence; day 14: <90% trained staff; days 15-17: <25% reduction vs Week 2 rate
mitigation: Audit Late Dispatch, Not Attempted and Time Shortage; fix route cut-offs; no early savings assumed
basis: Week 2 Riverside agent-side share 64.42%; base has no outcome benefit in first 14 days; stress 50% effectiveness and 21-day delay

kpi: Required attempts / effective standard capacity; actual open/aged assigned orders
threshold: >85% for 3 days prompts planning; >100% for any day or >1 day actual oldest overdue triggers escalation
mitigation: Temporarily operate between 85% and 100% with daily review; cap route load at standard and clear actual backlog
basis: Modelled planning queues at 85% are not observed backlog; standard-capacity queues shown separately

kpi: Customer-side Hold/Assigned and Returned/Assigned; agent return ratios
threshold: >20% relative increase vs hub Week 2 for 3 days with >=100 attempts; established agent >15% return ratio over >=30 attempts
mitigation: Address validation and customer calls; review Brookside Agent 45/Agent 46/Agent 47 locally; investigate before performance action
basis: Programme does not remove customer-side holds or returns; no return-cost savings booked

kpi: Donor and recipient utilisation; attendance and transfer-agent productivity
threshold: Donor projected >85% after move, recipient transfer productivity <80% for 2 days, or any missed shift
frequency: Before move; daily for first 7 days
mitigation: Confirm roster and same-cluster route familiarity; phase move if attendance fails; reverse if donor forecast deteriorates
basis: Only donors strictly below 75% in Week 2; search preserves peak donor target coverage; stress 80% first-week transfer productivity

kpi: Committed one-time spend + 28-day new payroll reserve
threshold: >BDT 70,000 prohibited; warn when uncommitted contingency <BDT 2,000 or any quote >10% above approved unit cost
mitigation: Track 28 paid days explicitly; fixed contracts for new hires; no spending of forecast savings until realised
basis: 26-day sensitivity is not authority to pay 28 days with a 26-day reserve
